s.d: (psychophysics) the difference between two stimuli that (under properly controlled experimental conditions) is detected as often as it is undetected
Just-noticeable difference, the amount by which something must be changed in order for it to be detectable at least 50% of the time.
x: Aleah's nosejob was not dramatic. It was more like a JND, around half her friends noticed it and the other half did not.
